name: Signal Lab Apify Tools
six_word_summary: Apify data APIs for AI agents
who: Signal Lab maintains the public integration and its Apify Actor portfolio.
what: A remote MCP entry point and developer-facing data APIs for transcripts, web-to-Markdown, price tracking, search intent, and other public-data workflows.
where: Runs on Apify; the public GitHub repository carries discovery manifests, Agent Skill metadata, docs, and links.
when: Use it when an AI agent or developer needs bounded web data or extraction workflows without building a scraper from scratch.
why: It turns common public-data collection tasks into reusable pay-per-use Actor/API calls and MCP-accessible workflows.
with: Apify Store Actors, Apify-hosted MCP/OAuth, standard HTTP APIs, and Agent Skills metadata.
watch: Remote hosted service; network calls leave the client and Apify authentication/payment may apply. No owner credentials are stored in this repository.
